name: Payid19 Crypto Payment Gateway
author: payid19

sections.description:
Payid19 lets your WooCommerce customers pay in cryptocurrency while your balance is always credited in USDT — with no chargebacks.

Two checkout modes:

  • On your site (White Label) — the customer pays without ever leaving your store. A clean, modern payment box shows the coin list, QR code, address and amount, and the order is completed automatically once the payment arrives.
  • Redirect — the customer is sent to a Payid19 hosted payment page in the design you choose: Classic, Slate, Paper or Mint.

Features

  • Accept USDT, USDC, Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB, TRON and Litecoin across their networks.
  • The customer pays in whichever coin they hold; you receive USDT.
  • No chargebacks.
  • Optional “customer pays the fee”, so you always receive the full order amount.
  • Works with both the classic checkout and the new WooCommerce Cart/Checkout blocks.
  • Test mode to try the whole flow before going live.
  • Choose the order status applied after a successful payment.

This is an official WooCommerce module by the Payid19.com team. See the FAQ for more.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, or search “Payid19” in the WordPress plugin directory, then activate it.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → Payid19 Crypto Payment Gateway.
  3. Paste your Public and Private keys from your Payid19 dashboard (Settings).
  4. Pick a checkout mode and, for Redirect mode, a payment-page design. Save.
  5. Turn on Test mode to try it, then turn it off before taking real payments.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Payid19 account?

Yes, a free account at https://payid19.com for your API keys.

Is there a chargeback risk?

No. Crypto payments cannot be charged back.

What is White Label mode?

The customer completes the payment on your own store — they never see payid19.com.
sections.changelog:
2.1.1

  • Fix: the payment-method icon (coin strip) could overflow and wrap to a second line on some checkout themes; it now stays on one line and scales to fit.

2.1.0

  • New: On-site White Label payment box, rebuilt from scratch — no external libraries, works on modern themes and with the WooCommerce checkout blocks.
  • New: Payment-page design selector for Redirect mode (Classic, Slate, Paper, Mint); Slate is the default.
  • New: Optional “customer pays the fee”.
  • New: Choose the order status applied after payment.
  • Fix: Block (Cart/Checkout blocks) integration now respects the enabled setting and loads correctly.
  • Fix: Webhook verification hardened (constant-time key check) and made idempotent.
  • Fix: Removed dependencies on discontinued CDNs and conflicting Bootstrap/jQuery plugins.
  • Fix: Corrected version metadata.

1.0.2

  • Earlier release.
